title: Resort Club Dependants and Member Guests: Extra-Person Charges on Room Reservations
content:
Resort Club Memberships at a resort cover some of the extra adults on the member's Room Reservations reservation at that same resort when an extra-person charge is added for adults beyond those the plan's rate covers.

## Benefit

When the guest holds an active Family Resort Club or Founders Resort Club membership at the same resort, as many of the adults beyond those the rate covers as the membership registers dependants are not charged; an active membership of any other level at that resort leaves 1 such adult uncharged as the member's guest; without an active club membership at that resort no adult is left uncharged (0). The adults left uncharged come off the adults beyond those the rate covers and never exceed them.

The benefit is read from the guest's Resort Club Memberships record at the resort of the reservation: the membership level, its status (only active counts) and the number of dependants registered on it besides the primary member.

| Membership at the same resort | Adults beyond those covered left uncharged |
|---|---|
| Family Resort Club or Founders Resort Club, active | as many as the dependants registered, up to the adults beyond those covered |
| Fitness Club, Pool & Fitness Club, Spa Club or Beach & Pool Club, active | 1 |
| Any level not active (pending, frozen, under notice, terminated) | 0 |
| No membership at that resort | 0 |

## Cases (hypothetical)

| Adults beyond those covered | Club membership at the resort | Dependants registered | Left uncharged | Adults charged |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2 | Family Resort Club, active | 3 | 2 | 0 |
| 2 | Founders Resort Club, active | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| 2 | Beach & Pool Club, active | — | 1 | 1 |
| 1 | Spa Club, active | — | 1 | 0 |
| 2 | Family Resort Club, frozen | 3 | 0 | 2 |
| 2 | none at that resort | — | 0 | 2 |
